Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “type of activity” as a granular accounting/operational category (“operating activities”) rather than recognizing the intended broad domain classification (“business”) shared by both “Owner earnings” (a business valuation concept) and Warren Buffett (a business/investing figure). The WebSurfer’s info was accurate; the error was in the Planner’s reasoning and premature finalization with the wrong category.
